cellacdc/shared/dialogs/base.py.doc:
Base class of the Cell-ACDC dialogs (from apps.py).

QBaseDialog subclasses the non-modal _base_widgets.py QBaseDialog
(exec_ runs a local event loop, Escape is ignored). Foundation leaf:
it imports only _base_widgets.py at module level, because most
dialog modules subclass it at import time. spotMAX subclasses it too.

cellacdc/shared/dialogs/generic.py.doc:
Generic input, list, tree and progress dialogs used by several program
parts, library modules (prompts.py, service/prompts.py) and shared
widgets (from apps.py).

QDialogCombobox, QLineEditDialog (with POSITIVE_FLOAT_REGEX),
NumericEntryDialog, QInput, QDialogEntriesWidget, the tree selectors
QTreeDialog, TreeSelectorDialog (spotMAX subclasses it) and
TreesSelectorDialog, SearchableListboxDialog (recent paths) and
QDialogWorkerProgress, plus the widgets that only these dialogs use.

cellacdc/shared/dialogs/file_selection.p.doc:
File, folder and Position selection dialogs used by several program
parts and batch utilities (from apps.py).

filenameDialog with FilenameEntryFormatter, SelectSegmFileDialog,
SelectFoldersToAnalyse (MODULES_TYPES is defined above it: its
signature annotation is evaluated at import), get_existing_directory,
the Position selection that load.py asks for
(SelectPositionFoldersDialogue) and selectPositionsMultiExp (spotMAX).

cellacdc/shared/dialogs/metadata.py.doc:
Image metadata dialog QDialogMetadata (from apps.py).

load.py (loadData) asks for it when the metadata is missing, and the
Edit metadata utility (utils/editMetadata.py) opens it.

cellacdc/shared/dialogs/image_tools.py.doc:
Image display tools shared by the main GUI, the GUI mixins, data prep,
data structure, the utilities and the 3D volume renderer (from apps.py).

The imageViewer slideshow, the z-crop tool QCropZtool, the points-layer
appearance dialog and group box (also used by volume_renderer/canvas.py),
OverlayLabelsAppearanceDialog and pgTestWindow (both unused). Sets
pyqtgraph's row-major image axis order at import, as apps.py did.

cellacdc/shared/dialogs/set_measurements.doc:
Set measurements dialog (from apps.py), used by the main GUI
(showSetMeasurements), the Compute measurements and Concatenate
utilities and the model parameters feature ranges.

SetMeasurementsDialog with its delete-unselected-columns prompt
askDeleteUncheckedExistingMeasurements, and the measurement errors
report ComputeMetricsErrorsDialog, plus the measurement group boxes
that only this dialog uses. Read the selection only via
selectedMetrics() / selectedMeasurements() (see CLAUDE.md).

cellacdc/shared/dialogs/combine_measurem.doc:
Combine-measurements equation editors (from apps.py).

_CombineMetricsDialog is also the base of the measurements viewer's
predictor, filter and conditional formatting editors, and
CombineMetricsEquationDialog is used by the main GUI, the Compute
measurements utility and the viewer.
Also FormulaEditWidget (also used to combine channels) and the unused
CombineFeaturesCalculator. The debug_trace decorator of
timepoint_predictors.py is applied at class-definition time. Keep
equation-editor.rst in sync when changing these editors.

cellacdc/shared/dialogs/preprocessing.py.doc:
Preprocessing and function-parameter dialogs (from apps.py).

ArgWidget, FunctionParamsDialog (emits every edit live), the recipe
widgets and dialogs PreProcessParamsWidget (also the base of the
viewer's measurement processing parameters), PreProcessRecipeDialog
(main GUI) and PreProcessRecipeDialogUtil (utilities, viewer), and the
combine-channels setup base CombineChannelsSetupDialog with
CombineChannelsWidget (subclassed in gui/dialogs/segmentation.py and
utils/combineChannels.py).

cellacdc/shared/dialogs/model_selection..doc:
Segmentation model selection and installation dialogs (from apps.py).

QDialogSelectModel (main GUI, segmentation module) with the custom model
instructions addCustomModelMessages, the weights download window
downloadModel (also myutils/segm_models.py, test_segm_model.py) and the PyTorch
install prompt InstallPyTorchDialog (myutils/torch_utils.py,
service/prompts.py), plus the model picker widgets only they use.

cellacdc/shared/dialogs/model_params.py.doc:
Model parameters window QDialogModelParams (from apps.py), used by the
main GUI, the segmentation module, prompts.py, the tracker
initialisation in myutils/segm_models.py and spotMAX.

Also its post-processing and feature-range sub-widgets
(PostProcessSegmParams, SelectFeaturesRange*) and the automatic
thresholding parameters QDialogAutomaticThresholding (main GUI and
segmentation module).

cellacdc/shared/dialogs/tracker_params.p.doc:
Tracker-specific parameter windows (Cell-ACDC, BayesianTracker, Delta)
opened by the tracker initialisation in myutils/segm_models.py
(from apps.py).

Paths to the tracker folders are built from cellacdc_path, not from
this file location.

cellacdc/gui/mixins/dialogs.py.doc:
Dialogs opened only from the GUI mixins in gui/mixins/, which the
measurements viewer also composes (from apps.py): changes here affect
both the main GUI and the viewer.

customAnnotationDialog (imports the measurements viewer's predictor
group box only locally, when the viewer passes predictorOptions),
AnnotateObjTrackSettingsDialog, FindIDDialog,
ViewCcaTableWindow (with DataFrameModel and pdDataFrameWidget),
ShortcutEditorDialog, ScaleBarPropertiesDialog,
TimestampPropertiesDialog, ObjectCountDialog and SetCustomLevelsLut.
Never import gui/main_window/, gui/dialogs/, gui/widgets/,
gui/workers/ or gui/helpers.py from here.

cellacdc/gui/dialogs/editing.py.doc:
Main-GUI-only dialogs to edit objects and annotations (from apps.py).

EditIDDialog, the manual separation window manualSeparateGui, the cell
cycle table editor editCcaTableWidget, the future-frames prompt
FutureFramesAction_QDialog and the unused wandToleranceWidget, plus the
helpers only they use. Sets pyqtgraph row-major image axis order at
import, as apps.py did.

cellacdc/gui/dialogs/segmentation.py.doc:
Main-GUI-only segmentation dialogs (from apps.py).

Promptable model selection and loading (SelectPromptableModelDialog,
LoadSavedPromptableModelDialog, addCustomPromptModelMessages), the model
info viewer ViewTextDialog, startStopFramesDialog, the post-processing
dialog PostProcessSegmDialog, the combine-channels setup
CombineChannelsSetupDialogGUI and the unused randomWalkerDialog, plus
the widgets only they use.

cellacdc/gui/dialogs/data_io.py.doc:
Main-GUI-only loading, saving, restore and export dialogs (from
apps.py).

QDialogZsliceAbsent, the save progress bar QDialogPbar, the
acdc_output version restore SelectAcdcDfVersionToRestore,
AutoSaveIntervalDialog and the export to video/image parameters
(ExportToVideoParametersDialog, ExportToImageParametersDialog), plus
the widgets only they use.

cellacdc/gui/dialogs/points_layers.py.doc:
Main-GUI-only Add points layer dialog AddPointsLayerDialog (from
apps.py). Its appearance group box comes from
shared/dialogs/image_tools.py (shared with the volume renderer).
Keys chosen here are checked against guiWin.reservedShortcuts.

cellacdc/launcher/dialogs.py.doc:
Launcher-only dialogs (from apps.py): the Track sub-cellular objects
setup TrackSubCellObjectsDialog, LogoDialog (only a commented use) and
the unused ChangeUserProfileFolderPathDialog, plus the widgets only
they use.

cellacdc/data_prep/dialogs.py.doc:
Data-prep-only dialogs (from apps.py): the sub-crops save paths
DataPrepSubCropsPathsDialog and the frame-range crop tool
QCropTrangeTool.

cellacdc/data_structure/dialogs/metadata.doc:
Data structure module dialogs for raw-file metadata and conversion
(from apps.py): the OME-XML metadata dialog QDialogMetadataXML and the
Fiji macro setup InitFijiMacroDialog, plus the widgets only they use.

cellacdc/data_structure/dialogs/setup.py.doc:
Data structure setup dialogs (from apps.py): DataStructureSetupDialogue
(data_structure/data_struct.py) and
ReStructTiffDataStructureSetupDialogue (data_structure/data_restruct.py),
plus the widgets only they use.

cellacdc/segmentation_module/dialogs.py.doc:
Prompts used only by the segmentation and tracking module
(segmentation_module/main_window.py; from apps.py): the stop-frame
selection askStopFrameSegm and the z-plane view askZPlaneView, which
imports launchDataPrepSelectZPlane locally from
data_prep/main_window.py.
